# hToAA_4gamma_ma1

**AIDA-Scout S4 (h -> a a, a -> gamma gamma)** -- generated by `make_signal_cards.py`.

A 125 GeV Higgs produced by gluon fusion decays to a pair of light pseudoscalars of mass 1 GeV, each decaying to gamma gamma. The final state is four gamma gamma objects sharing 125 GeV, so each carries roughly 31 GeV before any further decay.

## Configuration

* Hard process: `HiggsSM:gg2H`, m_h = 125 GeV
* `25:addChannel -> 36 36`, all SM Higgs decays closed
* m_a = 1 GeV, `36:addChannel -> 22 22`, prompt (`tau0 = 0`)
* No 2HDM+S UFO is required -- this is entirely a decay-table configuration, which is why it runs on the pythia branch
* Reference cross section sigma(gg->h) = **28.07 pb** (Pythia LO, no k-factor); rescale by your assumed BR(h->aa) -- see the normalisation warning shared with the S1 points

## Why it evades (or does not evade) the Phase-2 L1 menu

| Seed | Threshold | Fires? |
|---|---|---|
| PuppiHT | 450 (constituents pT > 30) | no |
| SinglePuppiJet | 230 | no |
| QuadJet | 400,70,55,40,40 | no |
| DoubleTkMuon (BPH) | 2,2, abs(eta)<1.5, dR<1.4, OS, dz<1cm | no |
| DoubleTkMuon (central) | 4,4 | no |
| DoubleTkElectron | 25,12 | no |
| DoubleTkIsoPhoton | 22,12 | **no** -- the DoubleTkIsoPhoton 22,12 floor is above a photon from a 1 GeV a; at low m_a the pair is collimated and reconstructs as one object |
| DoublePuppiTau | 52,52 | no |
| PuppiETmiss | 200 | no |


## Note -- collimation depends strongly on m_a

All three mass points give exactly 4.0 signal photons per event with a median pT around 21-24 GeV, but how they reconstruct differs:

| m_a | median dR(gamma gamma) | fraction with dR < 0.04 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 GeV | 0.047 | **0.38** |
| 5 GeV | 0.247 | 0.00 |
| 10 GeV | 0.506 | 0.00 |

At m_a = 1 GeV the pair is strongly collimated and a large fraction merges into a **single** EM cluster -- the 'photon jet' signature -- so do not interpret that point as four resolved photons. At 5 and 10 GeV the photons are well separated.

Note also that the median photon pT sits close to the DoubleTkIsoPhoton 22,12 threshold, so this sample is not automatically below the photon seed; check it at reconstruction level.

## Running

```bash
apptainer exec --bind $simdir \
  /cvmfs/unpacked.cern.ch/registry.hub.docker.com/jmduarte/mapyde:latest \
  sh $simdir/run.sh hToAA_4gamma_ma1 <nevents> <seed> $simdir False
```

This point uses the **pythia** branch of `run.sh`.
